newsitem.title: USA: VIMRX and Baxter to form new venture.
newsitem.headline: VIMRX and Baxter to form new venture.

text.p: VIMRX Pharmaceuticals said Thursday it has signed a letter of intent to form a new cell therapy company with Baxter Healthcare Corp, a unit of Baxter International Inc.
The company said the new company, yet to be named, will incorporate the assets of Baxter's immunotherapy division. The division had mroe than $9 million in revenues in 1996.
VIMRX will hold a majority stake in the new company, it said. Baxter will assume a minority position with one position on the board of directors.
The new company will be located in Irvine, Calif.
